_comment_00_about: VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 — Management Domain bring-up specification (SddcSpec). SAMPLE / TEMPLATE for a customer on REAL HARDWARE. Submit to the VCF Installer: POST https://<installer-fqdn>/v1/sddcs with a Bearer token obtained from POST /v1/tokens (user admin@local). Keys beginning with _comment* are documentation only and are ignored by the installer; you may delete them.
_comment_01_howto: Replace every <UPPER_CASE_TOKEN> with your site value. Numeric fields (vlanId, mtu) contain EXAMPLE numbers — change them to match your fabric. subnetMask assumes /24; adjust if different.
_comment_02_passwords: Every *Password field must meet VCF policy: 12+ characters incl. upper + lower + digit + special, no dictionary words, no repeats. Use a distinct strong password per component (shown here as separate tokens).
_comment_03_dns: EVERY hostname/FQDN below must have BOTH forward (A) and reverse (PTR) DNS records created BEFORE bring-up, and NTP must be reachable.
_comment_03b_skipvalidation: The three skip* fields below RELAX pre-checks. skipEsxThumbprintValidation=trusts ESXi SSL thumbprints without prompting; skipGatewayPingValidation=does not require gateways to answer ICMP; skipChecks[]=bypasses individual validators (NESTED_CPU_CHECK, NIC_COUNT_CHECK, MIN_HOST_CHECK, VSAN_ESA_HCL_CHECK, ESX_THUMBPRINT_CHECK). Needed for nested labs or when you knowingly accept a failing check. On fully HCL-certified physical hardware you may set the two booleans to false and use an empty skipChecks [] (or delete all three). NOTE: skipChecks[] is not present in every VCF Installer build's published OpenAPI schema — it was accepted in our validated bring-up but may be ignored on some builds; always confirm with a validate-only run (POST /v1/sddcs/validations) first.
_comment_04_hostname_convention: SHORT hostname is expected in: sddcManagerSpec.hostname, vcenterSpec.vcenterHostname, nsxtManagers[].hostname, hostSpecs[].hostname (installer appends dnsSpec.domain). FULL FQDN is expected in: nsxtSpec.vipFqdn, vspClusterSpec.*Fqdn, vcfAutomationSpec.hostname/platformFqdn, vcfOperationsSpec/CollectorSpec hostname, licenseServerSpec.hostname, vidbSpec.hostname. Preserve this split.
_comment_05_components: This deployment REQUIRES vcfAutomationSpec (VCF Automation) and vcfOperationsSpec (VCF Operations). Because those are present, the VCF Installer MANDATES vidbSpec (Identity Broker) — verified live: omitting it fails validation with VIDB_SPEC_MUST_BE_SET.error. vcfOperationsCollectorSpec + licenseServerSpec accompany the full stack. NSX Edge cluster + AVN are configured AFTER bring-up, not in this spec.

vcenterSpec._comment_vmSize: vmSize options: tiny|small|medium|large|xlarge. storageSize: lstorage|xlstorage. 'small'+'lstorage' suits most management domains; size up for large inventories.

nsxtSpec._comment: Production management domain uses a 3-node NSX Manager cluster. Provide 3 distinct short hostnames (each with DNS) plus the cluster VIP FQDN.

datastoreSpec._comment: vSAN OSA (esaConfig.enabled=false) — matches customer hardware. FTT=1 needs >=3 fault domains (4 hosts here). OSA expects each host to have cache + capacity disk groups. Switch to ESA (esaConfig.enabled=true) only on all-NVMe, ESA-HCL-certified hosts.

_comment_vsp: vspClusterSpec = VCF Management Platform / Fleet services (REQUIRED for the primary VCF instance). fleetFqdn is mandatory — omitting it makes 'Save VCF Management Components' fail with INVENTORY_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR. ipv4Pool must contain enough FREE management-subnet IPs (reserve a small contiguous block, all clean in DNS).
_comment_optionB: ----- OPTIONAL full-stack blocks below. Delete any you are not deploying. version strings must match the bundles available in your depot for this VCF 9.1 release. -----

vcfAutomationSpec._comment_internalCidr: internalClusterCidr is a non-routable overlay for the automation K8s cluster; it must NOT overlap any real network in your environment (e.g. a private /16 such as 172.27.0.0/16).

vcfOperationsSpec._comment_scale: Single master shown. For an HA Operations cluster add more nodes with type 'replica' / 'data' (and matching DNS).

vidbSpec._comment: VCF Identity Broker. REQUIRED because vcfAutomationSpec/vcfOperationsSpec are present (installer rejects the spec with VIDB_SPEC_MUST_BE_SET.error otherwise). version must match the vIDB bundle in your depot for this release.
